title: Expressions for New Year's Resolution
credits: Anna Matteo wrote this lesson for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: And now, Words and Their Stories, from VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们来了解“Words and Their Stories”，来自美国之音英语学习。

sentences.en: During a new year, many of us decide to try something new.
sentences.zh: 在新年的时候，我们许多人都会决定尝试一些新事物。

sentences.en: With a new year’s resolution, we resolve to do something we have not done in the past.
sentences.zh: 带着新年的决心，我们下定决心去做一些过去从未做过的事情。

sentences.en: Sometimes new things are risk-free – like eating healthier food or getting more exercise.
sentences.zh: 有时新事物是零风险的——比如吃得更健康或进行更多锻炼。

sentences.en: Sometimes we decide to learn a new skill, like a language or a musical instrument.
sentences.zh: 有时我们会决定学习一项新技能，比如一门语言或一种乐器。

sentences.en: Again, these things are not risky, nor do they have bad consequences.
sentences.zh: 同样，这些事情并不冒险，也不会有不良后果。

sentences.en: If you do not learn how to play the guitar, nothing bad will happen — probably.
sentences.zh: 如果你没学会弹吉他，不会有什么坏事发生——大概吧。

sentences.en: However, sometimes we need to shake up our lives and do something different that does have consequences.
sentences.zh: 然而，有时我们需要打破现状，去做一些确实会带来后果的不同事情。

sentences.en: That means there are risks if things do not work out.
sentences.zh: 这意味着如果事情没有如愿以偿，就会存在风险。

sentences.en: Such a change could involve moving to a new city, starting a new job, or ending a relationship.
sentences.zh: 这样的改变可能涉及搬到一个新城市、开始一份新工作，或结束一段关系。

sentences.en: These new things do have a level of risk .
sentences.zh: 这些新事物确实带有一定程度的风险。

sentences.en: Things could go wrong.
sentences.zh: 事情可能会出错。

sentences.en: On the other hand, things could go very right.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，事情也可能变得非常好。

sentences.en: So, for these situations, we introduce two expressions that encourage you to take a chance.
sentences.zh: 因此，针对这些情况，我们介绍两个鼓励你冒险一试的表达方式。

sentences.en: The first expression is nothing ventured, nothing gained.
sentences.zh: 第一个表达是“没有冒险，就没有收获”。

sentences.en: This means that without doing something risky or difficult, a bad situation will not improve.
sentences.zh: 这意味着如果不做一些冒险或困难的事情，糟糕的处境就不会改善。

sentences.en: You could also sum it up this way: If you try something risky, you could fail.
sentences.zh: 你也可以这样概括：如果你尝试冒险的事情，你可能会失败。

sentences.en: But if you do not try at all … you will surely fail.
sentences.zh: 但如果你根本不尝试……你肯定会失败。

sentences.en: The word “venture” can be both a noun and a verb.
sentences.zh: “venture”这个词既可以作名词，也可以作动词。

sentences.en: As a verb, it means to proceed in a dangerous or risky plan.
sentences.zh: 作为动词，它意味着在一个危险或冒险的计划中前行。

sentences.en: As a noun, it means an action that involves chance, risk, or danger.
sentences.zh: 作为名词，它指涉及偶然、风险或危险的行为。

sentences.en: For example, starting a new restaurant is a risky business venture these days.
sentences.zh: 例如，如今开一家新餐馆是一门有风险的商业投资。

sentences.en: And venturing into an unknown area could be dangerous.
sentences.zh: 而涉足一个未知的领域可能很危险。

sentences.en: A friend of mine wanted to learn how to drive a stunt car and then move to Los Angeles to become a stunt car driver.
sentences.zh: 我有一位朋友想学习如何驾驶特技车，然后搬到洛杉矶成为一名特技车司机。

sentences.en: A stunt car is a vehicle used in the movies to perform crashes and wild driving.
sentences.zh: 特技车是电影中用来表演撞车和疯狂驾驶的车辆。

sentences.en: There are not many women in this profession.
sentences.zh: 在这个行业里，女性并不多。

sentences.en: So, I told her that her decision involved lots of risk.
sentences.zh: 所以，我告诉她，她的决定涉及很多风险。

sentences.en: Our second expression is fortune favors the bold.
sentences.zh: 我们的第二个表达是“幸运垂青勇者”。

sentences.en: “Fortune” usually means wealth or fame.
sentences.zh: “Fortune”通常指财富或名声。

sentences.en: But it can also mean being in a good situation.
sentences.zh: 但它也可以指处于良好的处境。

sentences.en: And, if you are bold, you are brave.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果你勇敢，你就是无畏的。

sentences.en: So, this expression means that people who are brave and take chances help themselves.
sentences.zh: 所以，这个表达的意思是，勇敢并敢于冒险的人能成就自己。

sentences.en: Their bold, brave actions put them in a good place.
sentences.zh: 他们大胆勇敢的行为使他们处于有利的位置。

sentences.en: When using this expression, keep this in mind.
sentences.zh: 在使用这个表达时，请记住这一点。

sentences.en: The person who finds a fortune has done something to get it.
sentences.zh: 找到财富的人是通过某种努力才获得它的。

sentences.en: It just doesn’t happen to them by chance.
sentences.zh: 它只是不会偶然降临到他们身上。

sentences.en: So, if someone happens to win a lot of money in a lottery, you wouldn’t use the expression fortune favors the bold.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果某人碰巧在彩票中赢了很多钱，你就不会使用“幸运垂青勇者”这个表达了。

sentences.en: However, let’s say you quit your job and moved to a new city.
sentences.zh: 不过，假设你辞去了工作，搬到了一个新的城市。

sentences.en: That is a bold decision.
sentences.zh: 那是一个大胆的决定。

sentences.en: But you are sure that it will be good for you.
sentences.zh: 但你确信这对你是有好处的。

sentences.en: In the new city, you find your dream job.
sentences.zh: 在这座新的城市里，你找到了自己梦想中的工作。

sentences.en: It might even pay more money than your old job.
sentences.zh: 它甚至可能比你原来的工作赚更多的钱。

sentences.en: Here, you could definitely say, “Fortune favors the bold!”
sentences.zh: 在这里，你绝对可以说：“命运偏爱勇者！”

sentences.en: And that's all the time we have for this Words and Their Stories.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们这期“Words and Their Stories”的全部内容了。

sentences.en: For the start of 2023, I wish you and yours health and wealth.
sentences.zh: 在2023年伊始，我祝你和你的家人健康与财富。

sentences.en: Until next time … I’m Anna Matteo.
sentences.zh: 我们下期再见……我是安娜·马泰奥。

glossary.def: a promise to yourself to do something you believe you should do
the result of an action usually that is meaningful or serious
to make someone likely to take some action
(phrasal) to make a lot of changes or to make a big change
to do something that involves risk and reward
wealth, fame or good conditions (often because of influences beyond direct control of an individual)
to approve of or to support
not afraid of danger of difficult situations
